protocol.checkpoint_selection: first strictly lowest weighted validation BCE in 40 fixed epochs
protocol.threshold_selection: per output maximize validation F1 on 0.05..0.95 step .01; ties closest to .5, then higher
protocol.normalization: per-input/per-channel train-eligible population mean and SD over records/time; no record centering/filtering
protocol.unclassified: exclude from supervised loss and metrics; preserve split and save predictions with NA targets
protocol.multilabel_mixed: retain all provided labels including NORM+disease
protocol.binary: any disease MI/STTC/CD/HYP positive, NORM-only negative; mixed positive; unclassified excluded
protocol.test_policy: finish all 18 models and lock all thresholds/checkpoints before any test probability/metric calculation
protocol.AP_definition: AUPRC = non-interpolated average precision (sklearn.average_precision_score), not trapezoidal PR area
protocol.seed_interpretation: same records/splits/reconstruction NPZ repeated; SD ddof=1, not independent cohorts

note: Training protocol and aggregate metrics are unchanged. Runtime datasets and weights are supplied in the final handoff, not Git.
